header:

**hours of work at $20**
footer: $20/hr before tax · 2026 US prices · 1 work year = 2,080 hours

vo.text: Twenty bucks an hour. Netflix? **≈ 0.9 hours.**
An iPhone 17? **≈ 40.** A whole work week.
A year of groceries for four? **660 hours.**

of full-time work.

notes: Stress variant: 7 rungs, a fractional first rung at t = 0 (no intro: the first coin is already standing), a two-line item label, a long unit name, exact and rounded displays, a goal tone. Maths at $20/hr before tax: $17.99 ÷ $20 = 0.8995 h; $249 ÷ $20 = 12.45 h; $799 ÷ $20 = 39.95 h; $1,100 × 12 = $13,200, ÷ $20 = 660 h; $1,700 × 12 = $20,400, ÷ $20 = 1,020 h; $50,000 ÷ $20 = 2,500 h; $400,000 ÷ $20 = 20,000 h; 20,000 ÷ 2,080 h a year = 9.62 years (≈ 9.6). Prices: Netflix Standard $17.99/mo, AirPods Pro 3 $249 and iPhone 17 $799 (US launch prices, Sept 2025), average new-car transaction price ≈ $50,000 (KBB 2025); groceries and rent are stated assumptions.
